goal: Make VIctory a stable, playable Xbox Series S/X HLE emulator for GTA VI on the widest possible range of consumer hardware — AMD, NVIDIA, Intel Arc, varied CPUs, 8–64 GB RAM, 6–24 GB VRAM, Windows 10 and 11, HDD and NVMe — with no visual bugs, no crashes, stable frame pacing, and minimal resource usage.

philosophy.rationale: No task is ever fully closed. Each task is a direction of improvement, not a one-time fix. Different contributors will find different angles — a fix that halves VRAM on an RX 6600 may leave room for another contributor to halve it again on a 4 GB GPU. PRs that improve the same task from a different angle are always welcome as long as they pass eval-pr.ps1 and do not regress existing verified improvements.
philosophy.non_contradiction_rule: Every PR must be tested against the full crates/ unit test suite AND a live timed run. PRs that break a previously passing test, increase frame time on RX 6600, increase RAM/VRAM consumption, or introduce driver crashes on any supported GPU are rejected regardless of their stated intent.
philosophy.hardware_neutrality_rule: No optimization may hardcode a GPU vendor (AMD, NVIDIA, Intel), a specific RDNA/Turing/Xe generation, or a specific wave size. Use runtime detection (DXGI, D3D12 feature level queries, Rust cfg) or conservative safe defaults. Always test on Wave32 (NVIDIA) and Wave64 (AMD) semantics.

supported_hardware_matrix.ram_gb_target: 8–16 GB (must run stable at 16 GB; 8 GB should not crash)
supported_hardware_matrix.vram_gb_target: 6–8 GB minimum (must not OOM at 8 GB on RX 6600)

known_baselines.note: These are observed values on RX 6600 / 16 GB RAM / Windows 10. Use as reference floors — PRs should not regress these.
known_baselines.agility_sdk: D3D12SDKVersion=614 exported from victory.exe (commit ff8e29e0) — do NOT remove
known_baselines.texpool_classes: step /8, whole-slot slab heaps (commit b74ca2b6) — do NOT regress
known_baselines.ram_world: ~8.8–9.6 GB priv_mb at 25 s — open reduction target
known_baselines.vram_world: unknown exact, likely > 8 GB — open reduction target

tasks.title: Raise 3D world frame rate from 5–8 FPS toward stable 30 FPS
tasks.description: The game renders 8,800+ draws per frame in the 3D world. Any PR that measurably reduces per-frame CPU or GPU time — without crashing or regressing other tests — is welcome. Multiple non-overlapping PRs are encouraged (e.g. one for host.rs submission batching, another for list.rs sort, another for descriptor patching). Do not submit a single monolithic PR that touches everything.
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs — execute_inner, prewarm, finish_submission
crates/victory-gpu/src/list.rs — draw list sorting, culling, deduplication
crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor/host.rs — per-frame bindless descriptor patching
crates/victory-gpu/src/frame.rs — frame pacing, present, uncapped logic
crates/victory-gpu/src/queue.rs — submit batching, fence wait
crates/victory-gpu/src/shadow.rs — copy-back overhead
crates/victory-gpu/src/watch.rs — watch overhead per frame
tasks.acceptance: Timed live run shows measurable ms/frame reduction on RX 6600. All crates/victory-gpu unit tests pass. Zero crashes. Zero new driver warnings. Does not break Wave32 (NVIDIA) semantics.
anti_patterns: Do NOT hardcode wave size or vendor strings
Do NOT disable safety fences or barriers — race conditions are worse than slowdowns
Do NOT merge draw calls that have different root signatures or pipeline states without validating correctness

tasks.title: Reduce host RAM and VRAM usage to run on 16 GB RAM and 8 GB VRAM GPUs
tasks.description: Current observed: ~8.8–9.6 GB priv_mb at 25 s, climbing. VRAM target: fit cleanly in 8 GB (RX 6600). Multiple non-overlapping improvements are welcome: texture eviction, compressed heap reuse, resident set trimming, streaming LOD, etc. Each PR must scope its changes tightly and not conflict with the texpool baseline (commit b74ca2b6).
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/texpool.rs — texture slot pool (baseline: b74ca2b6, finer classes + whole-slot slabs)
crates/victory-gpu/src/resource.rs — GPU resource lifetime and eviction
crates/victory-gpu/src/memory.rs — heap allocation and committed memory tracking
crates/victory-gpu/src/texture.rs — texture upload, mip streaming
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/xmem.rs — XMemAlloc large-page host allocator
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/files.rs — RPF streaming buffer sizing
tasks.acceptance: Measurable reduction in priv_mb or VRAM committed in a live timed run. 6/6 texpool unit tests still pass (a_class_*, a_slab_*). Zero OOM crashes. Zero visual regressions (no missing textures, no corruption).
anti_patterns: Do NOT reduce pool sizes so aggressively that textures are constantly evicted — measure eviction rate
Do NOT change texpool class() step back to /4 (regression of b74ca2b6)
Do NOT touch xmem without verifying BCPack decompression still works

tasks.title: Speed up shader translation and pipeline compilation; fix driver-crashed compute shader
tasks.description: First-launch pipeline rebuild takes minutes of black screen. Compute shader f16876929fa64f9f crashes the AMD driver compiler. Shader cache invalidation is too aggressive. Improvements to parallelism, caching, and DXIL translation quality are all welcome.
where_to_look: crates/victory-shader/src/emit/ — DXIL/SPIR-V emitter, dead-code elimination
crates/victory-shader/src/opt/ — optimization passes
crates/victory-gpu/src/shader_cache.rs — disk cache keying and invalidation
crates/victory-gpu/src/pipeline/ — pipeline object creation, worker scheduling
crates/victory-gpu/src/pipeline/make.rs — BACKLOG_BUDGET, worker count (baseline: n/4, 5ms backlog budget)
tasks.acceptance: Faster measured pipeline build time. All victory-shader unit tests pass. No AMD/NVIDIA/Intel driver crashes. Does not remove or regress the pipeline worker budget fix (commit 66678857).
anti_patterns: Do NOT increase worker count above n/4 without profiling — was proven to hurt load FPS
Do NOT add vendor-specific DXIL paths without a runtime branch guarded by DXGI vendor ID

tasks.title: Ensure clean execution on AMD RDNA2/3/4, NVIDIA Ampere/Ada, and Intel Arc without vendor-specific hacks
tasks.description: The emulator was developed primarily on AMD hardware. NVIDIA uses Wave32 and has stricter DXIL validation. Intel Arc requires Resizable BAR and has different heap behavior. Any fix that improves compatibility without breaking AMD is valuable. PRs may be GPU-family scoped (e.g. 'fix Wave32 compute dispatch') as long as they do not regress AMD.
where_to_look: crates/victory-shader/ — wave size assumptions, SM6.6 intrinsic usage
crates/victory-gpu/src/device.rs — DXGI adapter queries, feature level detection
crates/victory-gpu/src/memory.rs — heap type selection (UPLOAD vs DEFAULT vs CUSTOM)
crates/victory-gpu/src/pipeline/ — root signature flags, SM version cap
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/kernel.rs — host DLL policy (amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_xbox.dll refused)
tasks.acceptance: No regression on AMD RX 6600 (all existing unit tests pass, frame time not worse). Documented test evidence on at least one additional GPU family (NVIDIA or Intel). Zero vendor strings hardcoded in Rust source.
anti_patterns: Do NOT hardcode 'AMD', 'NVIDIA', 'Intel' as string literals in GPU path selection — use DXGI vendor IDs (0x1002, 0x10DE, 0x8086)
Do NOT assume Wave64 — always use WaveGetLaneCount() dynamically or cap to Wave32
Do NOT require Resizable BAR unconditionally — keep gpu_upload=false fallback

tasks.title: Support stable gameplay on low-end hardware: 4–6 GB VRAM, 8 GB RAM, HDD, 4-core CPU
tasks.description: Target the floor of supported hardware: RX 6500 XT (4 GB VRAM), 8 GB RAM, HDD, 4-core/8-thread CPU. This means aggressive LOD, texture streaming, pipeline cache reuse, and worker thread caps. Must not degrade quality or FPS on higher-end hardware.
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/texpool.rs — slot eviction policy for VRAM pressure
crates/victory-gpu/src/resource.rs — resident set management
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dstorage.rs — staging buffer size (currently 32 MB), worker count (currently 16)
crates/victory-gpu/src/pipeline/make.rs — worker thread cap under low core count
crates/victory-formats/src/bcpack.rs — decompression throughput on HDD
tasks.acceptance: No OOM crash at 4 GB VRAM or 8 GB RAM (graceful degradation). No regression on RX 6600 / 16 GB baseline. HDD streaming must not cause corrupt textures or world pop-in gaps > 500ms.
anti_patterns: Do NOT reduce default staging buffer below 16 MB — will corrupt streaming on fast traversal
Do NOT evict pipeline cache entries — recompile cost is too high
Do NOT add quality reduction without a runtime VRAM-pressure gate

tasks.title: Fix any visual artifact: broken phone, missing water, lighting errors, texture corruption, shadow artifacts
tasks.description: Known issues: (1) opening the in-game phone leaves world unlit (black) with empty outline only; (2) water is missing on first run after shader cache rebuild until restart; (3) any other rendering artifact discovered. PRs fixing different artifacts are independent and do not conflict.
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/ambient.rs — ambient/global lighting state
crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs — render target transitions, UAV barriers
crates/victory-gpu/src/texture.rs — texture residency and promotion
crates/victory-gpu/src/list.rs — render pass ordering
crates/victory-shader/src/emit/ — incorrect DXIL translation producing wrong output
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dstorage.rs — first-run file ordering (water.rpf, shaders.rpf)
tasks.acceptance: Visual artifact no longer reproducible in a live session. Must not introduce new artifacts. All unit tests pass.
anti_patterns: Do NOT mask lighting bugs by boosting ambient — fix the state machine
Do NOT clear textures to magenta as a placeholder — fix the actual residency issue

tasks.title: Optimize DirectStorage queue, BCPack decompression, and RPF streaming for HDD and NVMe
tasks.description: World streaming and BCPack/zlib decompression hitch during fast traversal. Improvements to queue depth, decompression parallelism, read-ahead, and staging buffer management are welcome. PRs may target HDD or NVMe separately.
where_to_look: crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dstorage.rs — queue depth, staging buffer (currently 32 MB / 16 workers)
crates/victory-formats/src/bcpack.rs — BCPack block decompression, SIMD opportunities
crates/victory-formats/src/rpf.rs — RPF archive reader, seek patterns
tasks.acceptance: Faster measured decompression throughput (MB/s) or reduced hitch duration in a timed streaming test. Zero data corruption (hash-verify decompressed output). All victory-formats unit tests pass.
anti_patterns: Do NOT increase staging buffer above 128 MB without measuring RAM impact
Do NOT use unsafe SIMD without feature-gating on cpufeatures crate

tasks.title: Find and fix any crash, panic, deadlock, or device-removed error during normal gameplay
tasks.description: Any crash, Rust panic, D3D12 device removal, or deadlock found during gameplay is a valid target. Crashes may be intermittent — provide a reproduction step or log excerpt. PRs that add defensive checks, fix race conditions, or handle edge cases are always welcome.
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/ — fence waits, barrier transitions, descriptor heap overflow
crates/victory-hle/src/modules/ — HLE function panics on unexpected arguments
crates/victory-loader/src/ — image mapping, TLS redirect edge cases
apps/victory/src/main.rs — top-level panic handler
tasks.acceptance: Crash no longer reproducible. If intermittent, add a regression test or log assertion. All existing tests pass.
anti_patterns: Do NOT use unwrap() in hot paths — propagate errors
Do NOT silence a panic with catch_unwind without logging the error

tasks.title: Improve frame pacing: eliminate frame time spikes, hitches, and micro-stutters
tasks.description: Even at target FPS, irregular frame delivery causes perceived stutter. Improvements to present timing, fence pipelining, pipeline stall elimination, and GPU-CPU synchronization are welcome.
where_to_look: crates/victory-gpu/src/frame.rs — present mode, uncapped(), vsync logic
crates/victory-gpu/src/queue.rs — fence wait granularity
crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs — CPU-GPU sync points, prewarm
crates/victory-gpu/src/pipeline/make.rs — just-in-time stalls when pipeline not ready
tasks.acceptance: Measured reduction in frame time variance (99th percentile ms/frame) in a timed run. No regression to median FPS. All tests pass.
anti_patterns: Do NOT remove GPU-CPU synchronization fences — correctness first
Do NOT set present interval to 0 unconditionally — respect user's uncapped setting

tasks.title: Find and fix any bottleneck, bug, or incompatibility not covered by the tasks above
tasks.description: If you find a performance win, bug, or compatibility issue that does not fit the tasks above, open a PR. Discoveries from any area of crates/ or apps/ are valid — shader bugs, allocator inefficiencies, HLE correctness issues, input handling, audio glitches, etc. Describe the problem, the fix, and how you verified it.
where_to_look: crates/ — all crates are in scope
apps/ — victory loader and main binary
tasks.acceptance: Strictly scoped to VIctory-AMD functionality. Passes SECURITY-GATE.md scan. Includes at least one unit test or measured benchmark showing improvement. Zero regressions.
anti_patterns: Do NOT submit refactors with no measurable improvement
Do NOT submit changes to scripts/, .github/, or build infrastructure without prior discussion
